text: 新东方港股今日上涨超4%，带动新东方(EDU.US)美股盘前涨2.5%，此前已连涨3日。消息面上，公司此前发布的2026财年第四季度业绩非常亮眼。单季营收15.29亿美元，同比增长23%，超出市场预期，净利润更是同比飙升775.8%。全年来看，新东方营收达56.61亿美元，同比增长15.5%。优异的业绩为股价奠定了坚实基础。 多家券商在业绩发布后重申或上调了评级与目标价。例如，东方证券看好其教育新业务和大学生考培的韧性增长，并维持“买入”评级。大和证券也指出其海外业务重整有利利润率扩张。申万宏源更是大幅上调了公司的收入与利润预测，并重申“买入”。机构的一
text_en: New Oriental's Hong Kong shares rose over 4% today, lifting its US-listed shares (EDU.US) 2.5% premarket, following three consecutive days of gains. The company's FY2026 Q4 results were strong, with quarterly revenue of $1.529 billion, up 23% year-on-year and beating expectations, while net profit surged 775.8%. Full-year revenue reached $5.661 billion, up 15.5%. Several brokerages reaffirmed or raised ratings and target prices post-results, including Orient Securities maintaining a 'Buy' on resilient growth in new education businesses and test prep, Daiwa noting overseas restructuring supports margin expansion, and Shenwan Hongyuan sharply raising revenue and profit forecasts with a 'Buy' reiteration.
